name: POST /api/admin/dialer/scheduler/tick - Run one fair-share dispatch pass
description: Operator-only (x-admin-ops-token): runs one pass of the dialer's weighted fair-share scheduler — the same step the background loop runs when DIALER_SCHEDULER_ENABLED=true (180f8a01-0600-48b4-a0e5-f1be092f2fb3#AC2 — a large campaign from one tenant does not prevent other tenants' calls from being dispatched). Tenants with due queued calls are served in deficit round-robin: each gets quantum x weight dispatches per round, in turn, until budget is spent or no tenant can progress, so a tenant with a huge campaign takes only its share of each round. Each dispatch still honours that tenant's concurrency caps. Body: budget (1-5000, default 200), quantum (1-500, default 5), tenant_ids (optional uuid[] to restrict the pass). Returns {tick: {rounds, dispatched, by_tenant, capped}}.

testCases.name: Run a pass restricted to one tenant

errorCases.message: budget must be 1-5000 and quantum 1-500 | tenant_ids must be an array of uuids

errorCases.when: x-admin-ops-token missing or not a valid operator token
